metricBasis.sourceTiming: Controller receipt of accepted nonempty source events, from audio origin; excludes loading and preparation and is not pixel rendering or a click timestamp.
metricBasis.firstFinal: Earlier first final compares different segment granularity: VAD first committed source covers about 2.24s, energy first source window about 8s. It is not the same full sentence confirmed faster.
metricBasis.stableSource: First accepted source with nonempty stable prefix; all matrix cases are partial, not final. Lengths are UTF16 code units.
metricBasis.eof: lastSourceFinalAfterEofMs is signed final receipt minus EOF. Negative means final was already received before EOF; preserve the sign. drainMs is stop completion minus EOF and includes other cleanup.
metricBasis.endpoint: speechEndMs is the latest VAD-classified speech window end, not a manually annotated acoustic word boundary. speechEnd-to-enqueue includes silence hangover, frame delivery and VAD processing.
metricBasis.endpointPhases: queueWaitMs is recorded final enqueue-to-ASR start; finalAsrMs is start-to-completed; decodeToVisibleMs is completed-to-controller accepted source receipt. Their sum is enqueuedToVisibleMs. Cancellation acknowledgment wait is already included in queueWait and must not be added twice.
metricBasis.vadCost: Worker round-trip wall duration including IPC, not native CPU time or power. Energy-route zeros mean neural VAD was not called; RMS computation cost was not separately measured.
metricBasis.wer: Final lowercase English words, punctuation ignored. WER fraction and percent are separate. Segment punctuation and repeated words count according to flattened final word sequence; preview accuracy and translation are not scored.
metricBasis.aggregates: Across-fixture totals and medians describe this one matrix, not repeated-trial statistics; cleanup retest is excluded from original totals.
metricBasis.inputPolicy: No-zero-padding flags describe the declared fixture and harness policy. Actual input sample counts are checked against the fixture lengths; the flags are not independent measured counters.

observedMechanismLimits.scope: All 24 VAD endpoints in the matrix have reason=silence. The sustained-over-8s fixture contains natural JFK pauses, so it does not isolate continuous neural eight-second capping. real-eof has no appended zeros but its VAD final was triggered by silence while draining; forced EOF flush is covered by controlled unit tests instead. The 200ms inserted gap also includes source trailing/leading quiet and does not alone prove a pure 200ms pause is retained.
